title: Narrow refactor of query parsing onto the shared validators
goal: Refactor the query-parameter parsing in src/handlers/orders.ts to reuse the shared validation helpers, without changing which requests are accepted or the status and error code of rejected ones.

approvedRules.title: Keep the public response format
approvedRules.content: Every endpoint answers { data } or { error: { code, message } }. Never add, rename, or remove top-level response fields, and never return an empty body.

approvedRules.title: Use the shared validators
approvedRules.content: Validate request input with the helpers in src/lib/validate.ts and reply 400 VALIDATION_FAILED on bad input.

acceptance: The same limit values are accepted and rejected as before (missing → 50; integers 1–200 accepted; everything else 400 VALIDATION_FAILED)
Only the parsing code changes; the store, response shaping, and createOrder are untouched
The patch is small enough to review in a few minutes
